name: _treeview.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_treeview.scss — the treeview panel — collapsible under a toggle on mobile/tablet; folder/file nav list.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  // ── Treeview — collapsible panel under a toggle on mobile/tablet ─────
  &-nav-toggle {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    pointer-events: auto;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    text-align: left;
    color: inherit;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
    user-select: text;

    &::before {
      content: '▸ ';
    }

    &[aria-expanded='true']::before {
      content: '▾ ';
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &-nav {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: none;
    max-height: 70vh;
    overflow: auto;
    // Translucent surface + blur — the fixed scene backdrop stays visible
    // around the edges without fighting the tree text for contrast.
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 92%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

    .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav-open & {
      display: block;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: block;
      position: sticky;
      top: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  &-tree {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

    @include layout-960() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    }

    li {
      position: relative;
    }

    // Nested levels draw the ASCII-tree shape: a vertical rail running the
    // whole branch (cut to the stub at the last sibling → `└─`) plus a
    // horizontal stub landing mid-row on each item.
    ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
      margin: 0;

      li {
        &::before,
        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          left: -#{to-rem($space-sm)};
          background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 24%, transparent);
        }

        &::before {
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          width: to-rem($space-hairline);
        }

        &::after {
          top: calc(#{to-rem($space-sm)} + 0.6em);
          width: to-rem($space-sm);
          height: to-rem($space-hairline);
        }

        &:last-child::before {
          bottom: auto;
          height: calc(#{to-rem($space-sm)} + 0.6em);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  &-tree-item {
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: left;
    // Rows are <a href> (crawlable docs routes) — read as buttons did.
    text-decoration: none;
    // ≥34px row + side padding — a comfortable tap target on touch.
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
    width: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0.85;
    user-select: text;

    // Disclosure triangle for dirs — border-drawn so no glyph literal is
    // needed; rotates when the branch is open.
    &[aria-expanded]::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 0;
      height: 0;
      margin-right: to-rem($space-2xs);
      border-top: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
      border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
      border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
      vertical-align: middle;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    }

    &[aria-expanded='true']::before {
      transform: rotate(90deg);
    }

    &[aria-current='page'],
    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }
}
